### What problem does this PR solve?
<!--

Issue Number: close #54054

Problem Summary:

* when encode checksum, encode the bytes-level checksum
* remove code about the columns-level checksum 

### What changed and how does it work?

  > <!-- Or your custom  "No need to test" reasons -->

Upgrade Compatibility: old TiDB write column-level checksum, version is 0. after upgrade to the new version TiDB, should also can be read. This is tested.

issue_context.title: E2E Checksum support encode bytes-level checksum
issue_context.body:
## Feature Request

**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe:**
<!-- A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. I'm always frustrated when [...] -->

ref https://github.com/pingcap/tiflow/issues/10968

At the moment, E2E checksum functionality is implemented based on the column-level checksum mechanism, it cannot handle schema change issue well, especially `add column` and `drop column` scenarios.

**Describe the feature you'd like:**
<!-- A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. -->

There are 3 write paths in the TiDB related to the checkum functionality:

The [insert](https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/c39d79fca5a4e328d10e852ed750b9b4663847c8/pkg/table/tables/tables.go#L821) and [update](https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/c39d79fca5a4e328d10e852ed750b9b4663847c8/pkg/table/tables/tables.go#L439) path.

[DDL backfill data](https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/c39d79fca5a4e328d10e852ed750b9b4663847c8/pkg/ddl/column.go#L1325)

If there are more than one non-public columns, skip encode the checksum into the raw bytes, since the previous column-level checksum cannot handle multiple schema change case.

Bytes-level checksum should ba calculated based on all columns data which is encoded into raw bytes, also include the record key.


**Describe alternatives you've considered:**
<!-- A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered. -->

**Teachability, Documentation, Adoption, Migration Strategy:**
<!-- If you can, explain some scenarios how users might use this, situations it would be helpful in. Any API designs, mockups, or diagrams are also helpful. -->

review_comments: It's little dangerous to remove these code. If `r.flags` indicates that checksum exists but we forget to append checksum data, the data becomes malformed. Please at least add a comment to the method to declare that it's caller's responsibility to append checksum data.

The checksum cannot be appended at here, since it's not calculated yet.

The checksum is calculated by the `RawChecksum` and append to the `valueBytes` by it.
Does the calculation of `checksum2` need to be changed?

There is no need to calculate the `checksum2`, since the checksum is calculated based on the raw bytes, no other factors.

The field `checksum2` is still keeped, only used to read out the previous version write extra checksum, for upgrade compatibility. Actually, this field won't be used since `tidb_row_checksum()` calculate the column-level checksum in the realtime by using the latest schema.
If the failpoint is still in use, the above `checksumNeeded := ...` should be put after the failpoint, or just `checksumNeeded = true` in the failpoint.
